data-team-hovercards-enabled="true" class="markdown-body" data-turbolinks="false"><div class="markdown-body safe-html-box__Uwc6Al"><h2 dir="auto">Who's it for?</h2>
<p dir="auto">Users who want to subscribe to the newsletters</p>
<h2 dir="auto">Problems to be solved</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Our newsletter promo is currently getting a miniscule CTR from the <code class="notranslate">Sign up</code> button: Avg. 0.3% newsletters/session (See <span class="reference"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-issue-closed closed mr-1" title="Closed" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11.28 6.78a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06-1.06L7.25 8.69 5.78 7.22a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06l2 2a.75.75 0 0 0 1.06 0l3.5-3.5Z"></path><path d="M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Zm-1.5 0a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 13 0Z"></path></svg><a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="318902308" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2559" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2559/hovercard" href="https://github.com/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2559">Newsletter promo<span class="issue-shorthand"> #2559</span></a></span> for full analysis)</li>
<li>Marketing want to increase the number of signups to What's On ([see their recommendations])(<span class="reference"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-issue-closed closed mr-1" title="Closed" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11.28 6.78a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06-1.06L7.25 8.69 5.78 7.22a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06l2 2a.75.75 0 0 0 1.06 0l3.5-3.5Z"></path><path d="M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Zm-1.5 0a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 13 0Z"></path></svg><a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="326053261" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2703" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2703/hovercard?comment_id=558689254&comment_type=issue_comment" href="https://github.com/wellcomecollection/wellcomecollection.org/issues/2703#issuecomment-558689254">Improving newsletter signup flow<span class="issue-shorthand"> #2703 (comment)</span></a></span>)</li>
<li><code class="notranslate">/newsletter</code> page styling needs to be updated anyway as we're still on the old base page template</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">What does success look like?</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Percentage of site visitors who signed up</li>
<li>Increase average monthly subscribers by 5%</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Compare v1 vs v2 usage against same period last year</p>
<h2 dir="auto">Constraints</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Timeboxed: Finish by Friday 17 January 2020</li>
<li>Avoid background patterns that are buggy in IE11/Edge</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Where we can improve overall quality?</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Eliminate bugs in IE11</li>
<li>Responsive design</li>
<li>Content improvements - wording</li>
<li>Decoupling from footer</li>
<li>Form elements</li>
<li>Design of newsletter page</li>
<li>Better integration with card system</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Consider</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Success and error states</li>
<li>Newsletter-specific differentiation</li>
<li>Brand elements from print assets</li>
<li>Form validation (that scales to other forms)</li>
<li>Degradation</li>
<li>Does it need to be situated at bottom of content above footer?</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Decisions</h2>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Decided not to make it part of the footer because we may want an audience-specific newsletter to be promoted on relevant programme/activity pages</li>
</ul>
<h2 dir="auto">Testing</h2>
<p dir="auto">We'll AB test content of v2 : v2 (A) vs v2 (B)</p></div></div><div class="IssueBodyTaskList__-FlQre"><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 <blockquote>
<p dir="auto">‘consent’ of the data subject means any freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous indication of the data subject’s wishes by which he or she, by a statement or by a clear affirmative action, signifies agreement to the processing of personal data relating to him or her</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">All subscriptions are double opt-in, and as such the person entering an email address has to click the button that says, 'Yes, I want to receive email updates', under the paragraph, 'You've signed up to receive email updates from Wellcome Collection. <p dir="auto">Are we requiring users to consent to anything other than receiving the email itself. If not, then the clear affirmative action of clicking an unambiguous button seems good.</p>
<p dir="auto">If we need them to have have read, understood, and agreed with our privacy notice before signing up, then there may still be a case for the checkbox with words to that
